verses.text: For the choirmaster. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!

xrefs.text: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
And David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hill country of the Wilderness of Ziph. Day after day Saul searched for him, but God would not deliver David into his hand.
in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
At that very hour, some Pharisees came to Jesus and told Him, “Leave this place and get away, because Herod wants to kill You.

verses.text: For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.

xrefs.text: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,
“They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,” declares the LORD.
The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.

verses.text: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?”

xrefs.text: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins; you will restore the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of the Streets of Dwelling.
When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah
When the believers heard this, they lifted up their voices to God with one accord. “Sovereign Lord, they said, “You made the heaven and the earth and the sea and everything in them.

verses.text: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.

xrefs.text: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.
But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.

verses.text: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.

xrefs.text: There are six things that the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to Him:
Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
Some time later God tested Abraham and said to him, “Abraham!” “Here I am,” he answered.
Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.

verses.text: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.

xrefs.text: I will execute judgment upon him with plague and bloodshed. I will pour out torrents of rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.
Then the LORD rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah— from the LORD out of the heavens.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: In My wrath I will release a windstorm, and in My anger torrents of rain and hail will fall with destructive fury.
But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.

verses.text: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.

xrefs.text: They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.
As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
